In BST, diverge by comparison to both p and q.

For lca bst basic I will descend until the split point.

```python
def lca_bst(root, p, q):
    while root:
        if p.val < root.val and q.val < root.val: root = root.left
        elif p.val > root.val and q.val > root.val: root = root.right
        else: return root
```
